title: Does python activity in adf support abfss path?
question: We are migrating to new unity catalog workspace ,and we are trying to run adf pipelines with scripts in adls , previously ith old databricks workspace we used to call the scripts using dbfs path , but now we want to do the same with abfss without mounting
answer:
We are migrating to new unity catalog workspace ,and we are trying to run adf pipelines with scripts in adls , previously ith old databricks workspace we used to call the scripts using dbfs path , but now we want to do the same with abfss without mounting

The Databricks Python activity in Azure Data Factory currently only supports file paths that start with dbfs:/. At this time, using abfss:// paths directly isn't supported for specifying the Python file location. As a workaround, consider uploading your script to DBFS using the Databricks CLI, possibly integrated into your CI/CD pipeline. Refer this [Documentation].
